# Doug Tarry Homes

> > Doug Tarry Homes is a residential builder specializing in custom homes and planned communities across St. Thomas, Ontario, offering home plans, quick possession options, and rental properties.

Doug Tarry Homes develops residential communities in St. Thomas including Eagle Ridge, Harvest Run, Miller's Pond, and Avenue Heights, along with rental properties like 300 & 310 Manor. The company provides comprehensive homeowner support through Tarion warranty coverage and customer care resources.
